messages.body_plain:
Since recent updated version of CG all my scripts performed before on my datasets do not work at all.
the following error messages appears when I try to make global report statistitics

> stat.global<-compareGroups(~.,method=meth0,data=anemie)
Error in compareGroups.default(X = X, y = y, include.label = include.label,  :
  None variable can be computed

I do not understand the issue since severals month before all works perfectly?

Is it an issue with R studio ? with readr ?...
Please help me
Sincerely

It sounds strange. Few changes have been made in 3.2.2. version compared the the previous one (3.2.1), and none of them are related to compareGroups function.
Could you provide the value of "meth0" object? And, if possible, could you send your data set to the package maintainer email in order to reproduce your syntax?

Regards,

Isaac Subirana.
